model.name: Runway Aleph 2
model.shortDescription: Runway Aleph 2 by Runway ML edits real footage with text prompts. Remove objects, swap products, restyle or relight shots. Motion and audio preserved. Up to 30s at 1080p.

inputs.description: Describe how you want the video to look or feel after editing — style, atmosphere, visual changes. For example: 'transform into a noir film with high contrast and rain-soaked streets'.
inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.name: prompt

inputs.description: The source video to edit. Maximum 30 seconds and 16 MB. The model rewrites its visuals based on your prompt while preserving the original motion and structure.
inputs.label: Video
inputs.name: video

inputs.description: Pin reference images to specific moments in the video to guide the edit at those points. Add up to 5 keyframes. Use Seconds or Position to set each one's timing.
The reference image to use at this moment in the video.
inputs.label: Image
inputs.name: uri

inputs.description: When this keyframe applies, as a number of seconds from the start of the video.
inputs.label: Seconds
inputs.name: seconds

inputs.description: When this keyframe applies, as a fraction of the total video length. 0 = start, 1 = end, 0.5 = halfway.
inputs.label: Position
inputs.name: at

inputs.label: Keyframes
inputs.name: keyframes

inputs.description: Alternative to Keyframes — pin reference images to moments in the output video. Cannot be used together with Keyframes. Add up to 5 images.
The reference image to apply at this position in the output.
inputs.label: Image
inputs.name: uri

inputs.description: Whether to set the position using a timestamp in seconds or a percentage of the video's total length.
inputs.label: Position Type
inputs.name: positionType

inputs.description: When this image applies, as a number of seconds from the start of the output video.
inputs.label: Timestamp Seconds
inputs.name: timestampSeconds

inputs.description: When this image applies, as a fraction of the output video length. 0 = start, 1 = end.
inputs.label: Position Percentage
inputs.name: positionPercentage

inputs.label: Prompt Images
inputs.name: promptImage
